content.comment_body: Does the hardware itself lack enough memory to support an extended web project?

The device doesn't have internal memory for storing an extended web project. Such a project must be saved on a microSD card, making the card essential for utilizing the extended web server functionality.

analysis.insight_summary: Users realized that the [company_name] hardware does not provide sufficient internal storage for extended web projects created with [product_name] Web Editor, requiring reliance on a microSD card. This leads to uncertainty around standard memory capacities and necessary external hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the hardware to have enough internal memory to handle web projects without needing an additional microSD card.
